title: pidl: Another C99 type conversion
description:
Change an automated sizeof() call in the pidl dissector generation from
prefixing a "g" to a type to getting the actual C type via `mapScalarType`.

Ping #19116

notes.body: Not possible to replace directly to the value ?
Done, it now uses `mapScalarType()` from the `Parse::Pidl::Typelist` module to get the actual C type name.
Do you mean using a hash to convert the pidl type names to the C99 types?
